Why Industries Are Searching for a CPCB Approved RECD Vendor List

With enforcement tightening across India, industries are under increasing pressure to demonstrate verifiable CPCB compliance for their diesel generators.

During inspections, authorities no longer accept verbal assurances or generic marketing certificates. They verify:

  • Who supplied the RECD
  • Whether the vendor appears in CPCB-recognised records
  • Whether the installed device aligns with approved test reports

This has led to a surge in searches for:

  • “CPCB approved RECD vendors”
  • “Official CPCB RECD vendor list”
  • “CPCB compliant RECD manufacturers India”

Unlike earlier years when approval information was fragmented, the Central Pollution Control Board has now published an official reference document listing approved RECD vendors.

You can access the official list here:
👉https://novorbisitus.com/recd/retrofit-emission-control-device-recd-manufacturers-in-india-2026-list/

This document serves as an important starting point for industries seeking compliant vendors. However, understanding how vendor approval fits into the broader compliance ecosystem is equally important. For a complete overview, read our detailed guide on CPCB Approved Vendor Network & Compliance.

Is There an Official CPCB Approved RECD Vendor List?

Yes.

CPCB has published a formal document titled:

“List of RECD Vendors”

This PDF includes vendors whose RECD technologies have been evaluated and accepted as per CPCB guidelines for diesel generator emission control.

However, industries must understand something critical:

The list confirms approved technologies and vendors - but compliance still depends on correct installation, documentation, and capacity matching.

Being on the CPCB list does not remove the need for proper verification.

What the CPCB RECD Vendor List Actually Represents

The official CPCB vendor list indicates that:

  • The vendor’s RECD technology has undergone performance evaluation
  • Emission reduction performance meets CPCB requirements (minimum ≥70% PM reduction)
  • Testing and documentation have been reviewed
  • The technology is acceptable for retrofit compliance purposes

This list provides regulatory confidence and reduces procurement uncertainty.

However, it is not:

  • A ranking
  • A quality comparison
  • A performance hierarchy

It is a compliance recognition document.

How Industries Should Use the CPCB Vendor List Correctly

The CPCB RECD Vendor List should be used to:

✔ Shortlist vendors whose technology has regulatory acceptance
✔ Confirm vendor name matches the official CPCB document
✔ Begin detailed technical discussions
✔ Request model-specific documentation

It should not replace:

  • Capacity verification
  • Installation quality checks
  • Maintenance planning

The list is the first compliance filter - not the final step.

Important: Capacity & Model Verification Still Matters

Even if a vendor appears in the CPCB list, industries must verify:

  • Whether the specific RECD model matches your DG capacity
  • Whether testing covers your generator’s kVA range
  • Whether the installation follows approved methodology

Approval is typically capacity and configuration specific.

Using the wrong model or exceeding approved limits can still lead to inspection failure.

What Regulators Check During Inspections

During site inspections, authorities focus on:

  • Vendor name matching CPCB list
  • RECD test reports
  • Installation date
  • DG capacity vs approved range
  • Maintenance and operation logs

If documentation does not align with CPCB approval records, compliance may be questioned - even if the vendor appears on the official list.

Why Verification Is Still Essential

Even with an official vendor list available, industries must still:

  • Request latest test reports
  • Confirm documentation version
  • Ensure vendor support during inspections
  • Maintain proper compliance records

CPCB Vendor List vs Marketing Claims

Now that CPCB has released an official vendor list, industries should rely on:

  • The official CPCB PDF
  • Direct vendor documentation
  • Inspection-ready paperwork

Not:

  • Website claims without reference
  • Unverified “top 10” blogs
  • Outdated certificates

The official CPCB list provides a baseline of trust, but implementation quality still determines compliance success.

Why CPCB Approved Vendor Networks Are Still Important

Even with a formal vendor list, working within a structured vendor network provides:

  • Installation standardisation
  • Ongoing compliance support
  • Faster audit resolution
  • Documentation updates when norms evolve

To understand how structured vendor ecosystems reduce regulatory exposure and strengthen inspection readiness, explore our detailed resource on CPCB Approved Vendor Network & Compliance.

How This Vendor List Supports Long-Term Compliance

In 2026 and beyond:

  • Enforcement is documentation-driven
  • Inspections are data-based
  • Vendor traceability is mandatory

Using the official CPCB RECD Vendor List reduces procurement risk - but compliance depends on:

  • Correct vendor selection
  • Proper installation
  • Ongoing documentation management

For a deeper understanding of how structured vendor ecosystems strengthen regulatory readiness and long-term compliance, explore our comprehensive guide on CPCB Approved Vendor Network & Compliance.
